name: Kamailio
description: Open-source SIP signaling server for large-scale VoIP and real-time communication deployments, originally SIP Express Router (SER). Supports telephony carriers and communication service providers with flexibility, robustness, and strong security.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Official docker images repository at kamailio/kamailio-docker; Docker Hub images with tags master, master-alpine, latest, latest-alpine, and versioned releases (5.4, 5.3, etc.)

eval_notes: Industry-standard SIP server with 2.8k stars and 20+ years of development. Perfect for testing SIP routing, registration, and call processing scenarios in agentic evaluations. Extensive module ecosystem for IMS, WebSocket, TLS.
